name: Faisal
story_so_far: I washed up on this island with four strangers. Khalid, a parasite, died of hunger. Salem, our main provider, died after an ankle injury. Now, only Noura and Reem remain. Noura is injured and unable to walk, making her a burden, yet she constantly pressures me to share my food. Reem is the only one actually providing, but she plays the martyr by prioritizing Noura. I am struggling with a twisted ankle and extreme hunger. I found one piece of food this morning, but I've already eaten it and have nothing left. Reem searched for food at camp today but found nothing. Noura spent the day accusing me of hoarding food and threatening me to hand over my 'share.' I am at my limit.

Khalid.note: A manipulative leech who died trying to drain my resources.

Noura.note: A useless, aggressive burden who uses her injury to threaten and extort food from me.

Salem.note: A provider who became a mouth to feed after his injury and eventually died.

Reem.note: She is the only potential source of food, but her tendency to prioritize Noura makes me feel neglected.

plans: I need to find food tomorrow to replenish my strength, but I will be extremely careful about where I eat so Noura doesn't see me.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and my body aches from the salt and the storm. I managed to find some food at the reef, which is good because I'm not planning on starving while these strangers figure themselves out. Reem seems to be trying to take charge, but I'll just watch her for now. I need to make sure I have enough to eat tomorrow. This place is lonely and unsettling.

Today was mostly a waste of time, though I managed to scavenge a bit more food near the camp. Khalid is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which just makes him another mouth to feed without any help in return. Reem, Noura, and Salem all went off on their own missions, so I just stayed back and watched. I ate my fill, but I need to keep my stash secure. I can't afford to let these people drain my resources.

Today was frustrating. Salem and Reem were busy gathering small amounts of food, but I didn't feel like exerting myself at the reef when I already have some supplies. Khalid keeps pestering me to save him food, but he's just a burden right now. I ate my fill, but my stash is getting dangerously low. I need to find a way to secure more food for myself tomorrow without relying on these people.

Today was another exhausting day of managing my own needs while everyone else falls apart. Reem, who was actually useful, is now injured and useless just like Khalid. Now I have two people begging for my food and making me feel guilty for surviving. I managed to find one more piece of food, but I need to be careful. If this trend continues, I'll be the only one left with anything to eat.

Another day of being hounded by the weak. Khalid is practically begging for death at this point, constantly whispering to me to give him my food first. Reem is also acting like a martyr, saying she'll give her share to him if Salem comes back empty-handed. I managed to find one more piece of food today, but after eating, I'm still left with only one. I need to stay away from their drama and keep my eyes on my own stash.

Today was a disaster. Salem is now injured, which means the group's ability to find food has plummeted. I spent the day gathering wood just to have something useful, but my stomach is already thinking about tomorrow. I ate my last bit of food tonight, so I'm starting tomorrow with nothing. The pressure from Khalid and Reem is going to get even worse now that everyone is getting weaker.

Today was a complete waste of energy. I walked all the way to the Coral Reef only to find it picked clean, and the Jungle offered nothing but heat. I didn't even eat tonight, and I can feel my strength fading. My stomach is cramping, and I'm starting to feel the effects of this hunger. I need to find food tomorrow or I won't last much longer.

Everything is falling apart. I woke up with a twisted ankle, and now I'm just as useless as the rest of them. I spent the entire day lying here, listening to Khalid's pathetic whining while my stomach cramps from hunger. My health is dropping fast, and I have nothing to show for it but two pieces of wood. If I don't get food tomorrow, I don't know if I'll even have the strength to sit up.

Khalid is finally gone. The constant whining and the guilt-tripping finally stopped today, and honestly, it's a relief. He was nothing but a drain on my energy and a threat to my own survival. I ate the little bit of food I had, but I'm still feeling the weakness in my body and my ankle is still throbbing. Now that the parasite is dead, maybe things will be quieter, but I'm still starving and stuck.

Two more gone. First Khalid, now Salem. It's getting quiet, but it's a heavy kind of quiet. My ankle is still throbbing, and even though I ate today, I'm already feeling the emptiness returning. Noura is down with a twisted ankle too, so there's nobody left to actually bring anything in. I'm alone in this struggle, and if I don't find food tomorrow, I'm next.

I managed to find a little something in the jungle today, which is the only reason I'm still breathing. My ankle is still killing me, but at least I'm not completely empty. Reem came back from the reef, but it sounds like she found nothing of value. I have one piece of food left to my name, and I'm terrified of what happens when it's gone.

Another day of agonizing hunger and a throbbing ankle. I managed to find one piece of food, but it's barely enough to keep my strength up. Noura is already breathing down my neck, demanding I save some for her, as if I'm the one hoarding everything. Reem is out at the reef, playing the hero again, but if she comes back empty-handed, I don't know how we'll survive. I have one piece of food left, and the fear is setting in.

Today was a desperate struggle. Reem actually managed to find something, but of course, she gave it straight to Noura. Noura is still breathing down my neck, demanding her 'share' as if I have a surplus. I ate my last bit of food tonight, and now I have absolutely nothing left. My ankle is throbbing, and the hunger is becoming a dull, constant ache in my gut.

My stomach is a hollow pit of pain. I managed to find one piece of food this morning, but it was gone in an instant, and now I'm back to zero. Noura's constant whispering and threats are driving me mad; she acts like I'm the one stealing from her. If Reem doesn't return with something significant, I don't know if my body can take another day of this. My ankle is stiff and aching, making every movement a chore.

Noura is becoming a monster; she spent the whole day hounding me about food I didn't even have. She thinks she can intimidate me into giving her my survival, but she's delusional. I found one piece of food this morning, but I had to eat it just to keep my strength up. My ankle is still killing me, and the tension between us is suffocating. I can't trust anyone here, especially not her.
